independence_evidence: The magazine runs its own site and Paris-based Shopify shop under the Exhibition Magazine name (contact via exhibition-collectif.com) with no media-group owner mentioned; it is a small Paris fashion-and-art title distributed by KD Presse (https://www.exhibition-magazine.com/legal-mentions, https://exhibition-shop-9341.myshopify.com/meta.json).
qualifies_reason: Independent Paris biannual with a new print issue (N°27, Fall/Winter 2026/27) released in October 2026.
what_it_is: Exhibition is a very large-format Paris fashion and art magazine published twice a year, each issue built on a single theme (Excess, Ti Amo, Craft, Stories) and sold with four or more alternative covers by different photographers. Inside are fashion series by international photographers and stylists, conversations with designers, make-up artists and architects, and art portfolios. It is for readers and collectors of oversized, image-led fashion publications.
